## Example 3.2 {#dc3-example-3-2-b .dc-lesson }

<p><strong>b)</strong> Find the exact gradient of the tangent to the curve $y=2\sin x$ at $x=\dfrac\pi6$.</p><p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 17 · Example 3.2(b)</p>

::: notes
Differentiate first: dy/dx=2 cos x. At pi/6, gradient=2(sqrt(3)/2)=sqrt(3). Distinguish the function value 1 from the gradient sqrt(3). Keep the exact value. About one minute.
:::
